description: This Java test class verifies the configuration builder for FineractFeignClientConfig, ensuring default values, custom configurations, and creation of API client interfaces work properly.

classes.name: FineractFeignClientConfigTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the FineractFeignClientConfig builder and client creation.

methods.name: testBuilderDefaults
methods.description: Tests that the default configuration builder creates a non-null config object.

methods.name: testBuilderConfiguration
methods.description: Verifies custom configurations like base URL, credentials, timeouts, and debug mode produce a non-null config object.

methods.name: testConnectionTimeToLiveConfiguration
methods.description: Checks that connection time to live can be set and results in a non-null configuration.

methods.name: testEncoderDecoderConfiguration
methods.description: Ensures that a default configuration can be built and is non-null.

methods.name: testErrorDecoderConfiguration
methods.description: Ensures that error decoder configuration doesn't prevent config creation.

methods.name: testClientCreation
methods.description: Verifies that a client interface (TestApi) can be created from the configuration and is non-null.
